title: Newton's Method
text: The formula for Newton's Method is given by $$x_{n+1}=x_n-\frac{f(x_n)}{f'(x_n)}$$. $$To$$ $$find$$ $$fixed$$ $$points$$, $$iterate$$ $$over$$ $$Newton's$$ $$method$$ $$until$$ $$the$$ $$points$$ $$seem$$ $$to$$ $$converge$$ $$on$$ $$a$$ $$number$$ $$(the$$ $$fixed$$ $$point)$$.
